pest.name: Cockroaches
pest.advice: Common in Melbourne kitchens; usually treated in one visit with gel baiting. Not dangerous, but multiplies quickly.
pest.included: Inspection, gel bait and residual spray in kitchen and wet areas, exterior perimeter, 3-month warranty.
pest.variables: Heavy infestation, roof-void access, multiple units, or German cockroaches needing a follow-up visit.

prep.step: Clear benches and under-sink cupboards in the kitchen.
Keep pets in a separate room or outside for 2 hours after treatment.

pest.name: Ants
pest.advice: Trails usually lead back to a nest outside. Non-repellent baits reach the colony instead of scattering it.
pest.included: Inspection, non-repellent perimeter spray, granular bait at nest entries, 3-month warranty.
pest.variables: Multiple nests, carpenter ants in timber, or ants nesting inside wall cavities.

prep.step: Wipe up food spills but leave the ant trails visible so the technician can follow them.
Move pot plants away from the house perimeter.

pest.name: Spiders
pest.advice: Most house spiders are harmless, but redbacks and white-tails near living areas are worth treating.
pest.included: Inspection, web removal, residual spray to eaves, window frames and sheds, 6-month warranty.
pest.variables: Two-storey eaves, large sheds or dense garden beds against the house.

prep.step: Clear access to eaves, the garage and window frames.

pest.name: Rats & mice
pest.advice: Rodents gnaw wiring and contaminate food. Book soon; we also find and seal the entry points.
pest.included: Roof-void inspection, tamper-proof bait stations, entry-point report, follow-up check.
pest.variables: Roof access difficulty, the number of bait stations needed, or proofing work to seal entry points.

prep.step: Make sure the manhole to the roof space is accessible.

pest.name: Termites
pest.advice: Possible termite activity always needs a professional inspection. Do not disturb the timber or spray it yourself.
pest.included: Full timber pest inspection with thermal camera and moisture meter, and a written report with treatment options.
pest.variables: Treatment (baiting or a chemical barrier) is quoted separately after the inspection.

prep.step: Do not break open or spray any damaged timber.
Clear access under the house and to the roof space.

pest.name: Wasps & bees
pest.advice: European wasps can sting repeatedly. Keep clear of the nest; honey bees are relocated rather than destroyed where possible.
pest.included: Nest location, treatment and removal where accessible, 1-month warranty.
pest.variables: Nests inside wall cavities or at height, or honey-bee swarms needing a beekeeper.

prep.step: Keep children and pets away from the nest area.

pest.name: Bed bugs
pest.advice: Bed bugs hide in seams and frames and need two treatments about two weeks apart to break the life cycle.
pest.included: Two visits: inspection and treatment of beds and furniture, then a follow-up treatment after 14 days.
pest.variables: The number of rooms affected and whether furniture must be heat-treated or disposed of.

prep.step: Wash all bedding on a hot cycle and bag it until after treatment.
Clear items from under the beds.

pest.name: Fleas
pest.advice: Treat the pets with a vet product on the same day as the house, or the fleas come straight back.
pest.included: Interior carpet and floor treatment, pet bedding areas and the yard, 1-month warranty.
pest.variables: Large yards, many carpeted rooms or untreated pets.

prep.step: Vacuum all floors thoroughly on the morning of the treatment.
Treat pets with a vet flea product on the same day.
